integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv v1 record for math/0406494 is dated 2004-06-24.

scientific_limitations: Complex rational normal curves in their standard projective embeddings.
Only proper secant varieties are covered; the original curve is included as the k=0 member.
The theorem is about projective degrees and their prime-adic valuations, not singularities or defining ideals.
An unindexed source could contain the same arithmetic consequence of the classical binomial degree formula.
title: A binary phase law for degrees in the rational-normal secant tower
